name: Hitotsubashi Hall
address: Tokyo 101-8439 National Center of Sciences Building (reception desk on the 2F), 2-1-2 Hitotsubashi, Chiyoda-ku
accessSummary: Jimbocho Station (Hanzomon, Mita and Shinjuku Lines) Exits A8 and A9: 4 min walk / Takebashi Station (Tozai Line) Exit 1b: 4 min walk
hours: 9:00-21:00. Three time slots: morning (9:00-13:00), afternoon (13:00-17:00) and evening (17:00-21:00), each including setup and teardown time. Closed during the year-end and New Year holidays, building inspection days, etc.
notice: Rental is limited to meetings on academic or higher-education subjects held by universities, academic societies, national or local governments, etc. (Article 2 of the Rules of Use, revised October 1, 2025).

rooms.name: Hitotsubashi Hall (main hall)
rooms.note: Fixed seats: 521 (494 on the 1st floor, 27 on the 2nd floor). With note-taking tables. 2 wheelchair spaces. 6 interpreter booths and 500 simultaneous interpretation receivers. No food or drink in the hall (water for speakers only). Usage fee: morning 188,500 yen / afternoon 227,300 yen / evening 246,200 yen (from October 1, 2025)

rooms.name: Medium Conference Room 1
rooms.note: Capacity 64 (32 desks, 64 chairs). Rooms 1 to 4 combined: 240. Usage fee for Medium Conference Rooms 1 to 4: morning 49,200 yen / afternoon 58,700 yen / evening 63,900 yen

rooms.name: Medium Conference Room 4
rooms.note: Capacity 48 (24 desks, 48 chairs). If you use the main video and audio equipment, book including Medium Conference Room 4. The assembly-type simultaneous interpretation booth and 200 receivers are for Medium Conference Room 4 only

rooms.name: Conference Room 201
rooms.note: Capacity 16 (8 desks, 16 chairs). Rooms 201 to 203 combined: 48. Usage fee for Rooms 201 to 203: morning 24,100 yen / afternoon 28,300 yen / evening 30,400 yen

rooms.name: Conference Room 203
rooms.note: Capacity 16 (10 desks, 16 chairs). If you use the main video and audio equipment, book including Room 203

rooms.name: Special Conference Room 101
rooms.note: Capacity 24 (12 desks, 24 chairs). Rooms 101 to 103 combined: 72. If you use the main video and audio equipment, book including Room 101. Usage fee for Rooms 101 to 103: morning 29,300 yen / afternoon 34,500 yen / evening 37,700 yen

rooms.name: VIP Room
rooms.note: Capacity 14 (14 sofa seats). For receiving guests and lecturers. Usage fee: morning 17,800 yen / afternoon 21,000 yen / evening 23,000 yen

rooms.name: Preparation Room
rooms.note: Capacity 14 (2 tables, 10 chairs, 2 two-seater sofas). Can be used as an event office, waiting room, etc. Usage fee: morning 6,300 yen / afternoon 8,400 yen / evening 8,400 yen

ops.prevDaySetup: There is no time slot for setup alone; book the previous day's evening slot (17:00-21:00) separately. You cannot enter and start setting up before your booked time. For multi-day use where equipment or exhibition panels stay in place until the last day, an all-day booking is required.
ops.loadingHours: The service yard for load-in and load-out (up to 2-ton short trucks) is open 8:30-21:00. The freight elevator has a load capacity of 1,800 kg; the car interior is 1,820 mm wide x 2,120 mm deep x 2,780 mm high, and the entrance is 1,370 mm wide x 2,290 mm high. When moving items by hand truck, cover the passage with protective material able to bear the weight. Packages sent in advance are received on weekdays 9:00-17:00 only, and packages left after use are held until they are shipped on the next weekday (parking classification table as of October 2022; guidance as of October 2025).
ops.vehicleRules: The service yard is for temporary stopping of load-in and load-out vehicles: up to 2-ton short trucks, maximum 1 hour, application form required (weekdays and weekends/holidays, 8:30-21:00). Every parking area requires a prior usage notification and is allocated in order of application. It can be used only during the booked meeting room time (as of October 2022).
ops.parking: The underground parking for speakers and organizers has up to 4 spaces (vehicle height up to 1,550 mm, width 1,850 mm, length 4,850 mm; weekdays 9:00-21:00; approval permit required). The driveway parking for chauffeur-driven cars has up to 3 spaces, maximum 3 hours, and the accessible parking has 1 space, maximum 3 hours. There is no parking for general attendees. Buses and microbuses cannot enter the driveway (as of October 2022).
ops.waitingRooms: The Hitotsubashi Hall main hall has a simple waiting room (facilities section of the Hitotsubashi Hall page). The Preparation Room (30㎡, 14 people) can also be used as an event office or waiting room, and the VIP Room (56㎡, 14 people) is for receiving guests and lecturers.
ops.catering: No food or drink is allowed in the Hitotsubashi Hall main hall (water for speakers only). Other meeting rooms allow food and drink; in the 2F lobby and corridors, drinks only. The hall introduces caterers with a track record over the past 3 years: Josui Kaikan, C's Catering Service and Ajikobo Suisen (not partner companies; users place orders directly; July 2026).
